question: In a Van de Graaff generator, the charge given to the inner side of a large hollow spherical conductor is found on its outer surface. Explain why this helps the generator develop a very high potential.

options.A: The charge remains on the inner surface and prevents further charge transfer
options.B: Charge supplied to the inner side moves to the outer surface, so more charge can be added and the potential rises as $V=\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\frac{Q}{R}$
options.C: The charge is destroyed inside the conductor, causing high potential
options.D: The spherical conductor becomes an insulator and traps charge in its volume
